parameters.content:
## Import v6
1. Unpublish v5 (same bot) BEFORE publishing v6. Keep v1–v5 exports.
2. Import; select Apps Script VehicleLedger in Procesar, Procesar con IA, and Vincular; confirm the /exec URL.
3. Reassign Telegram and Gemini credentials (IA texto uses HTTP Google Gemini(PaLM) Api authentication). Error workflow: cuentas-errores-v1.
4. T-019: deploy Apps Script with Pdf.gs FIRST. The bot unlocks password-protected PDFs using the vehicle plate and returns archivoIA for Recuperar archivo/PDF and Procesar con IA. Without Pdf.gs this follows the v5 path.
5. Publish and test text, buttons, voice, photos, PDFs, and password-protected PDFs (SOAT).

parameters.content:
WhatsApp input accepts a direct update or {update}; the external input calls mode=each with waitForSubWorkflow=false. Enviar respuesta waits for Cuentas - Enviar v1: replace CONFIGURE_ENVIAR_WORKFLOW_ID. Its numeric messageId feeds Vincular (WA uses the group copy). T-049: getFile remains Telegram-only. WA media: Config WA (match Graph version with cuentas-enviar-v1) → metadata → validate HTTPS host/MIME/10 MB → download without redirects → binary data → Armar archivo. Configure WhatsApp VehicleLedger credentials in both HTTP nodes. Failures pass through Apps Script permissions/update_id checks and produce a visible resend response. Apps Script locking and deduplication are unchanged.

T-048: both triggers pass through Preparar entrada. Only WA with context_id reads wa_contexto. Validate recipient, age <=7 days, numeric message_id, and offered callback. Invalid/expired buttons end silently; replies without context continue as normal text. Leer vigencia WA rejects a superseded menu for the same TG copy. Callback reservation: from:context_id:data → insert → wait 2 s → lowest ID, owner $execution.id. Apps Script handles wamid retries as update_id wa_.... Tables and cleanup belong to the send subworkflow. T-049: voice, photo, and PDF use the shared AI path and fallbacks; live n8n/Meta tests remain pending.

nodes.name: Leer vigencia WA
nodes.notes: Latest wamid saved for the same recipient and TG copy. Saves are sequential: split messages save the interactive part last. Prevents reuse of buttons from an earlier stage of the same question.

nodes.name: Esperar candado WA
nodes.notes: Reference reservation pattern: persist, wait 2 s, and select the lowest ID. Business decisions remain under the single Apps Script writer; this is not an atomic mutex.
